pages.text: The $(item)Awakening Apparatus$() is an ancient ritual table. By placing a compatible weapon on it and channeling the power of an $(item)Arcane Hilt$(), you can unlock its true magical potential and allow it to store spells.
The ritual to craft the Awakening Apparatus.
Crafting the Arcane Hilt requires a great amount of Source.

pages.title: Awakening Ritual
pages.text: To awaken a weapon, right-click the empty $(item)Awakening Apparatus$() with the weapon to place it on it. Then, holding an $(item)Arcane Hilt$(), right-click the apparatus to consume it and complete the ritual.

pages.title: Inscription
pages.text: With an awakened weapon placed on the $(item)Awakening Apparatus$(), you can inscribe magic into it. Hold a $(item)Spell Parchment$() (with your desired spell) and right-click. The spell will be engraved on the weapon forever.
